subject.title: feat(agents): return sessionId from sessions_spawn accept payload

question: Should accepted native `sessions_spawn` results permanently expose the durable child `sessionId` and the additional `sessionKey` alias as part of the agent-facing tool contract?
rationale: The implementation is additive and plausibly useful, but it expands the stable shape of an agent tool result and promises a persistent session-state identifier beyond the existing child-session key and run ID.

options.title: Accept the durable identity contract
options.body: Keep `sessionId` and `sessionKey`, with focused proof that every accepted creation and fork path returns the persisted child identity.

options.title: Narrow the addition
options.body: Expose only `sessionId` if maintainers want the durable lookup capability without introducing a second spelling for `childSessionKey`.

options.title: Defer the API expansion
options.body: Leave the current accepted-result shape unchanged until a broader session-tool contract direction is agreed.

recommendation.title: Accept the durable identity contract
recommendation.body: Keep `sessionId` and `sessionKey`, with focused proof that every accepted creation and fork path returns the persisted child identity.

likelyOwner.reason: No individual ownership trail could be established confidently from the available review evidence; the decision belongs with the current agents/session-area owners.
